# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

tissues <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

# miRNA cluster colors — identical to 03_miRNA_mRNA_circus_20260421.Rmd
cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD",
  "2" = "#FDCDAC",
  "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4",
  "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.6.1_integrated_module_view", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output:", dir_output, "\n")
```

# 3. Load data

```{r helpers}
find_latest_dated_dir <- function(base) {
  dirs  <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  dated <- sort(dirs[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(dirs))],
                decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(dated) == 0) stop("No dated subdirectory under: ", base)
  cat("Using:", dated[1], "\n")
  dated[1]
}
```

## 3a. Logistic regression results from 04.4.3

```{r load_logistic}
dir_04_4_3  <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.4.3_module_activity"))
logistic_df <- read.csv(file.path(dir_04_4_3, "logistic_enrichment.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(module = as.character(module))

cat("Logistic results:", nrow(logistic_df), "tissue-modules\n")
cat("Significant (OR>1, p_adj<0.05):",
    sum(logistic_df$OR > 1 & logistic_df$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## 3b. miRNA cluster–module mapping from 04.5

```{r load_mirna_module}
dir_04_5     <- find_latest_dated_dir(file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.5_mirna_module_mapping"))
mirna_mod_df <- read.csv(file.path(dir_04_5, "mirna_module_full.csv"),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster),
         module        = as.character(module))

# Reconstruct cluster × module aggregation (one row per tissue × cluster × module)
cluster_module_agg <- mirna_mod_df %>%
  distinct(tissue, miRNA_cluster, module, module_id, n_pathways)

cat("miRNA cluster-module pairs:", nrow(cluster_module_agg), "\n")
```

# 4. Build shared column order

Use the union of module_ids from both datasets, ordered by tissue then module number.

```{r col_order}
all_mods <- bind_rows(
  logistic_df        %>% distinct(tissue, module, module_id) %>% mutate(module = as.character(module)),
  cluster_module_agg %>% distinct(tissue, module, module_id) %>% mutate(module = as.character(module))
) %>%
  distinct(tissue, module, module_id) %>%
  mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = tissues)) %>%
  arrange(tissue, as.integer(module))

col_order  <- all_mods$module_id
col_split  <- factor(sub("_mod.*$", "", col_order), levels = tissues)

cat("Total columns (module_ids):", length(col_order), "\n")
```

# 5. Build matrices

## 5a. Logistic regression vector (log2OR per module_id)

```{r logistic_vec}
log2or_vec    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(col_order)), col_order)
log2ci_lo_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(col_order)), col_order)
log2ci_hi_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(col_order)), col_order)
p_adj_vec     <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(col_order)), col_order)
or_vec        <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(col_order)), col_order)

for (mid in intersect(col_order, logistic_df$module_id)) {
  r <- logistic_df[logistic_df$module_id == mid, ][1, ]
  log2or_vec[mid]    <- r$log2OR
  log2ci_lo_vec[mid] <- log2(pmax(r$CI_lo, 1e-6))
  log2ci_hi_vec[mid] <- log2(pmax(r$CI_hi, 1e-6))
  p_adj_vec[mid]     <- r$p_adj
  or_vec[mid]        <- r$OR
}

sig_enriched <- !is.na(p_adj_vec) & p_adj_vec < 0.05 & or_vec > 1
sig_depleted <- !is.na(p_adj_vec) & p_adj_vec < 0.05 & or_vec < 1

pt_col <- ifelse(sig_enriched, "#D73027",
          ifelse(sig_depleted, "#4575B4", "grey60"))
pt_col[is.na(log2or_vec)] <- NA_character_

cat("Modules with logistic data:", sum(!is.na(log2or_vec)), "/", length(col_order), "\n")
cat("Significant enriched (OR>1, p_adj<0.05):", sum(sig_enriched), "\n")
cat("Significant depleted (OR<1, p_adj<0.05):", sum(sig_depleted), "\n")

# y-axis range for forest plot (pad 15%)
finite_ci <- c(log2ci_lo_vec, log2ci_hi_vec, log2or_vec)
finite_ci <- finite_ci[is.finite(finite_ci)]
ypad          <- diff(range(finite_ci)) * 0.15
ylim_forest   <- range(finite_ci) + c(-ypad, ypad)
if (diff(ylim_forest) < 0.5) ylim_forest <- c(-1, 1)
```

## 5b. miRNA cluster × module matrix

```{r cluster_mat}
clu_row_order <- as.character(sort(as.integer(names(cluster_colors))))

mat_all <- cluster_module_agg %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_cluster, module_id, n_pathways) %>%
  tidyr::complete(miRNA_cluster = clu_row_order,
                  module_id     = col_order,
                  fill          = list(n_pathways = 0L)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = module_id, values_from = n_pathways, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  column_to_rownames("miRNA_cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

mat_all <- mat_all[clu_row_order, col_order, drop = FALSE]

mat_log <- log1p(mat_all)
max_log <- max(mat_log, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Heatmap matrix:", nrow(mat_all), "rows ×", ncol(mat_all), "columns\n")
```

# 6. Combined heatmap

```{r combined_heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# ── Top annotation: forest plot (log2OR + 95% CI) ───────────────────────────
# Positional (unnamed) vectors — indexed by column position within col_order
or_pos    <- unname(log2or_vec)
ci_lo_pos <- unname(log2ci_lo_vec)
ci_hi_pos <- unname(log2ci_hi_vec)
col_pos   <- unname(pt_col)

total_n_cols <- length(or_pos)

forest_fn <- AnnotationFunction(
  fun = function(index) {
    n        <- length(index)
    lo       <- ylim_forest[1]
    hi       <- ylim_forest[2]
    is_first <- index[1] == 1

    pushViewport(viewport(xscale = c(0.5, n + 0.5), yscale = c(lo, hi),
                          clip = "off"))

    # Dashed reference line at log2OR = 0
    grid.lines(unit(c(0.5, n + 0.5), "native"), unit(c(0, 0), "native"),
               gp = gpar(col = "grey50", lty = "dashed", lwd = 0.8))

    hw <- 0.22   # whisker half-width in native x units

    for (k in seq_along(index)) {
      i   <- index[k]
      col <- col_pos[i]
      if (is.na(or_pos[i]) || is.na(col)) next

      # CI segment + end caps
      lo_i <- ci_lo_pos[i]; hi_i <- ci_hi_pos[i]
      if (!is.na(lo_i) && !is.na(hi_i)) {
        grid.segments(unit(k, "native"), unit(lo_i, "native"),
                      unit(k, "native"), unit(hi_i, "native"),
                      gp = gpar(col = col, lwd = 1.4))
        for (yy in c(lo_i, hi_i)) {
          grid.segments(unit(k - hw, "native"), unit(yy, "native"),
                        unit(k + hw, "native"), unit(yy, "native"),
                        gp = gpar(col = col, lwd = 1.4))
        }
      }

      # Central point
      grid.points(unit(k, "native"), unit(or_pos[i], "native"),
                  pch = 16, size = unit(1.8, "mm"),
                  gp  = gpar(col = col))
    }

    # ── Border: surround each tissue split ───────────────────────────────────
    grid.rect(gp = gpar(col = "grey30", fill = NA, lwd = 1.2))

    # ── Y-axis: leftmost split only ───────────────────────────────────────────
    if (is_first) {
      y_at <- pretty(c(lo, hi), n = 5)
      y_at <- y_at[y_at >= lo & y_at <= hi]
      grid.yaxis(at    = y_at,
                 label = as.character(round(y_at, 1)),
                 main  = TRUE,
                 gp    = gpar(fontsize = 7))
      grid.text("log2OR",
                x   = unit(-3.5, "lines"),
                y   = unit(0.5, "npc"),
                rot = 90,
                gp  = gpar(fontsize = 8))
    }

    upViewport()
  },
  which = "column",
  n     = total_n_cols
)

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  log2OR = forest_fn,
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  height               = unit(4, "cm")
)

# ── Left annotation: cluster color bar ──────────────────────────────────────
row_cols <- cluster_colors[rownames(mat_all)]
row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  cluster = anno_simple(
    rownames(mat_all),
    col   = row_cols,
    width = unit(5, "mm")
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  show_legend          = FALSE
)

# ── Heatmap body: miRNA cluster × module (log1p n_pathways) ─────────────────
col_fn <- colorRamp2(c(0, max_log / 2, max_log),
                     c("#F0F0F0", "#FC8D59", "#D73027"))

cell_size <- unit(7, "mm")   # square cell side length

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_log,
  name              = "n pathways\n(log1p)",
  col               = col_fn,
  na_col            = "grey90",
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  column_split      = col_split,
  column_gap        = unit(4, "mm"),
  border_gp         = gpar(col = "grey30", lwd = 1.2),
  rect_gp           = gpar(col = "white",  lwd = 0.4),
  top_annotation    = top_anno,
  left_annotation   = row_anno,
  width             = cell_size * ncol(mat_log),
  height            = cell_size * nrow(mat_log),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    v <- mat_all[i, j]
    if (v > 0)
      grid.text(v, x, y,
                gp = gpar(fontsize = 7,
                           col = ifelse(mat_log[i, j] > max_log * 0.6,
                                        "white", "grey20")))
  },
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_rot  = 45,
  column_title_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  row_title         = NULL,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
    at             = log1p(c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10)),
    labels         = c("0", "1", "2", "5", "10")
  )
)

# ── Legends ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lgd_cluster <- Legend(
  labels    = names(row_cols),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = row_cols),
  title     = "miRNA cluster",
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

lgd_logistic <- Legend(
  labels    = c("Enriched (OR>1, p_adj<0.05)", "Depleted (OR<1, p_adj<0.05)", "n.s. / no data"),
  legend_gp = gpar(col = c("#D73027", "#4575B4", "grey60")),
  title     = "miRNA target enrichment",
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  type      = "points",
  pch       = 16
)

draw(ht,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cluster, lgd_logistic),
     merge_legend            = FALSE)

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_cols <- ncol(mat_all)
w_in   <- max(14, n_cols * 0.38 + 5)

png(file.path(dir_output, "integrated_module_view.png"),
    width = max(2400, n_cols * 58 + 600), height = 1400, res = 150)
draw(ht,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cluster, lgd_logistic),
     merge_legend            = FALSE)
dev.off()

svg(file.path(dir_output, "integrated_module_view.svg"),
    width = w_in, height = 9)
draw(ht,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_cluster, lgd_logistic),
     merge_legend            = FALSE)
dev.off()

cat("Saved: integrated_module_view.png / .svg\n")
```

# 7. Summary table

Modules that are both significantly enriched for miRNA targets (04.4.3)
and linked to at least one miRNA cluster via pathway enrichment (04.5).

```{r summary_table}
logistic_sig <- logistic_df %>%
  filter(OR > 1, p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, module, module_id, OR, log2OR, CI_lo, CI_hi, p_adj)

cluster_coverage <- cluster_module_agg %>%
  group_by(tissue, module, module_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_clusters        = n_distinct(miRNA_cluster),
    cluster_list      = paste(sort(unique(miRNA_cluster)), collapse = ", "),
    total_n_pathways  = sum(n_pathways),
    .groups           = "drop"
  )

# Join miRNA names per module_id
mirna_per_mod <- mirna_mod_df %>%
  group_by(tissue, module, module_id) %>%
  summarise(
    miRNA_list = paste(sort(unique(sub("^mmu-", "", miRNA_Name))), collapse = ", "),
    n_miRNAs   = n_distinct(miRNA_Name),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

summary_tbl <- logistic_sig %>%
  left_join(cluster_coverage, by = c("tissue", "module", "module_id")) %>%
  left_join(mirna_per_mod,    by = c("tissue", "module", "module_id")) %>%
  arrange(tissue, p_adj) %>%
  mutate(across(c(OR, log2OR, CI_lo, CI_hi, p_adj), ~ round(., 4)),
         linked_to_cluster = !is.na(n_clusters))

cat("=== Enriched modules (OR>1, p_adj<0.05) ===\n")
summary_tbl %>% print(n = Inf)

write.csv(summary_tbl,
          file.path(dir_output, "integrated_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved: integrated_summary.csv\n")
```
